title: Everyone merges: each session merges its own PR with the merge tool.
ruling: Owner words, typed in the coordinator's session at 12:58 CST Nov 16 (relayed by the coordinator at 13:07 CST; not read by triage): "No now everyone merges message consultant, ensure it gives you the shpeal, and then spread the message to your lanes". The consultant's text (13:04 CST, relayed to lanes 13:05 CST; triage did not read it): each session merges its own PR with the merge tool (lane, standing, batch runner); lanes no longer hand a finished PR to runner 10. Limits stay: green run of the PR's own head, lane lint PASS, review rounds, record at the live head, merge tool only. Private repos (q_max, degen, home, ios-adblock, joyous) hold until PR #3590 and a setup PR per repo. || CONFLICT RESOLVED 15:46:27 CST Nov 16 (triage 9, from the coordinator's 15:47 CST relay; PR 3592 REST: merged true, merged_at 21:46:27Z). Who marks a lane's PR ready: the lane marks its own PR ready once, after its last review and lane lint (decision draft-until-reviewed Q2, now live). PR 3592 'A lane marks its own PR ready' (lane lane-may-mark-ready) changes guard merge-role-proof and the merge tool so a lane's --ready call, with the lane role, a step its own record proves and its own lane branch, is allowed; a bare --ready, a wrong head, a step the record lacks and an unreadable pull request stay refused. It rewrites the Lane draft PR grant line and the decision to say Q2 is live. The grant (Nov 12 17:19 CST) and Q2 no longer conflict. Merge commit 9f99c153811d per the coordinator, not read by triage. Still open from this ruling: the private repos hold until their setup PR per repo (PR 3590 merged 15:43:12 CST).
